title: Personal e-banking transfer tariff
what_it_establishes: Cross-border wire (telegraphic): 1 per mille of amount, min CNY 50, max CNY 260 per transfer; plus cable fee CNY 80 (HK/MO/TW) / CNY 150 (other regions). Standard since 2014-11-01. Note: agreements/discounts/local differences may apply.

title: ATM fee announcement (from 2026-11-11)
what_it_establishes: Overseas ATM: UnionPay CNY 12 + 1% of withdrawal, max CNY 112 per withdrawal; Mastercard/VISA 2.5%, min USD 3, max USD 40.

title: Personal FX (08), 2026-07-13 - Art. 59
what_it_establishes: Art. 59: a foreign individual (jingwai geren) with lawful RMB current-account income in China buys FX at a bank with valid ID + source-of-funds materials including tax vouchers.

title: Current-account Q&A (09), 2024-06-21
what_it_establishes: Same Art. 59, plus: only a foreign individual holding a Foreign Permanent Resident ID gets the annual purchase convenience amount.

title: FX policy Q&A (08), 2022-09-29
what_it_establishes: Personal settlement and domestic-individual purchase use an annual convenience amount of USD 50,000 per person per year. It is not a cap: above USD 50,000 ID alone is insufficient; source/use materials are needed.

title: Personal FX (03), 2024-02-29 - Art. 64
what_it_establishes: Art. 64 (domestic individuals): FX-account FX remitted abroad up to USD 50,000/day with ID; above that, ID + transaction materials. FX banknotes remitted up to USD 10,000/day with ID; above that, ID + customs-stamped declaration or original withdrawal slip + materials.

title: Current Account Guidelines (2020), Arts. 54-67
what_it_establishes: Art. 65: foreign individual's FX-account FX remitted abroad with ID; FX banknotes up to USD 10,000/day with ID. Art. 67: transfers between domestic and foreign individuals' FX accounts count as cross-border. (PDF text via excerpt; see Flagged F11.)

title: Personal FX (10), 2026-09-17 - Art. 60
what_it_establishes: Art. 60: unused RMB from own FX exchange reconverted with ID + original exchange slip; slip valid 24 months. Up to USD 500/day (USD 1,000 pre-departure) with ID alone.

title: Personal FX (08), 2025-06-13 - Art. 62
what_it_establishes: Art. 62: borrowing another person's convenience amount or otherwise evading the amount/authenticity rules puts the person on a watchlist for that year + 2 years. (Not opened in full in this session; see F11.)

title: Service-trade FX Q&A (04), 2021-11-02
what_it_establishes: Foreign individual remitting RMB income from service trade, income and current transfers buys FX with ID + transaction proof including tax vouchers (tax filing form, tax payment or exemption certificate). (Not opened in full; see F11.)

title: Order [2004] No. 16 - personal property transfer
what_it_establishes: Emigrant transfer = person moving from mainland to live abroad who liquidates pre-move lawful property and buys/remits FX. Inheritance transfer = foreign/HK/MO resident liquidating inherited mainland estate. Docs include tax certificate/payment voucher. Bank remits directly to applicant's own account abroad; no FX cash withdrawal. False documents punished under Regulation Art. 40.

title: Capital account notice (as amended), 2024-09-03
what_it_establishes: Sec. 6: emigrant approval by former-hukou SAFE office; inheritance by decedent's last-hukou office; RMB 500,000 HQ-report rule and staged-remittance rule removed (bank may remit once or in instalments within approval); notarisation of property/agent documents removed. Sec. 5: profit remittance above USD 50,000 needs profit-distribution resolution + tax filing form.

title: Property-transfer Q&A (07), 2026-03-19
what_it_establishes: Capital Account Guidelines 2024, 6.4: emigrant transfer approved by former-hukou SAFE office; inheritance by decedent's last-hukou office. (Not opened in full; see F11.)

title: Cross-border financing guide, Sec. 8, 2025-09-25
what_it_establishes: Sec. 8: foreign individual selling mainland commodity housing remits proceeds with passport, registered sale contract/title docs, tax voucher; amount may not exceed price less taxes/fees in the sale. (Contents read; Sec. 8 text via excerpt; see F11.)

title: Announcement 2013 No. 40 (as amended)
what_it_establishes: Single outbound payment of USD 50,000+ (exclusive) in listed categories (incl. foreign individual's China work pay, dividends, real-property transfer income) needs tax filing with the tax office. (Not opened in full; see F11.)

title: FX Administration Regulation (Order 532)
what_it_establishes: Art. 5: current-account payments/transfers not restricted. Art. 12: genuine lawful basis. Art. 39 (flight of FX): fine up to 30%; serious 30%-100%; criminal liability. Art. 40 (false docs to buy FX): same scale. Art. 42 (carrying FX in breach): warning, fine up to 20%. Art. 45 (private FX dealing): warning, confiscation, fine up to 30%; serious 30%-100%. Art. 48: untrue docs, individuals up to CNY 50,000. Art. 52(2): domestic individual = Chinese citizen or foreigner resident in China 1 continuous year.

title: Individual FX Measures (Order [2006] No. 3)
what_it_establishes: Art. 13: foreign individual with lawful RMB current-account income buys FX/remits with ID + proof. Art. 14: unused inbound FX returned the same way with ID. Art. 28: bank sets account-holder category from ID at account opening. (Not opened in full; see F11.)

title: Card overseas cash withdrawal notice (2017 No. 29)
what_it_establishes: Per person (all own cards incl. supplementary): overseas cash withdrawals capped at CNY 100,000/year; over the cap, suspended that year and next. Per card per day: CNY 10,000. Borrowing/lending cards to evade is prohibited.

title: Cash-carry Q&A, 2019-05-21
what_it_establishes: FX banknotes carried out: up to USD 5,000 customs direct release; USD 5,000-10,000 bank-issued carry permit; above USD 10,000 SAFE permit in principle not granted except special cases.

title: Online FX exchange reminder, 2020-03-04
what_it_establishes: Personal settlement/purchase must go through qualified designated banks, licensed bureaus or agency outlets; private swaps, app swaps, money changers and underground banks are unlawful. No splitting to evade limits; no false documents. (Not opened in full; see F11.)

title: Splitting case (Zhu), 2017-04-14
what_it_establishes: Circular 2009 No. 56 pattern: 5+ different persons buying FX same/adjacent/continuous days then remitting to one overseas person/institution. Zhu used 52 people for USD 2.5625m; classed as flight of FX, fined under Art. 39. (Not opened in full; see F11.)

issuer: People's Bank of China et al.
title: Notice 2026 No. 42 (virtual currency), 2026-02-06
what_it_establishes: Virtual-currency business is unlawful financial activity; fiat/virtual-currency exchange in China is strictly prohibited and will be banned. (Not opened in full; see F11.)

title: Cross-border RMB policy, 2018-11-09
what_it_establishes: Circular 2018 No. 3 supports individuals' other current-account RMB cross-border settlement; example: foreign employee in Beijing remitted RMB salary directly abroad instead of first buying FX. (Not opened in full; see F11.)

title: Personal Income Tax Law (2018)
what_it_establishes: Art. 3(3): interest, dividends, property rental, property transfer and incidental income taxed at flat 20%. Art. 6(5): property-transfer income = proceeds less original value and reasonable costs.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
what_it_establishes: China Yuan yearly averages: 2025: 7.129; 2024: 7.189; 2023: 7.075; 2022: 6.730; 2021: 6.452. Divide foreign amount by the rate to get USD.

title: US-China Income Tax Convention, Art. 9
what_it_establishes: Art. 9(2): dividends may be taxed in the payer's state under its law, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner the tax shall not exceed 10% of gross dividends.

title: Guide to CNY transfers (from-CNY)
what_it_establishes: From-CNY eligibility: not mainland Chinese; worked/had worked in China; valid China tax record showing taxes paid within last 3 years. Bank-app max CNY 300,000/transfer; Alipay max CNY 50,000/transfer. Overall limit = China salary less tax paid; does not expire. Recipient must be own account. Fee and FX rate are shown only in-app (not published on this page).

title: Send money from China
what_it_establishes: Bank-account delivery temporarily unavailable; cash pickup only (online via partner-bank app or in person at partner bank). IDs: China ID card, passport (excl. HK/MO/TW passports), Mainland Travel Permit. Fee/FX not published on this page.

title: Wire transfers
what_it_establishes: Inbound wires may incur a USD 15 fee per wire (schedule of fees controls). Outbound international USD wire USD 45; foreign-currency wire no fee but FX markup applies.

title: Publication 525 (2025)
what_it_establishes: Personal foreign-currency transaction: gain of USD 200 or less need not be included; gain over USD 200 reported as capital gain. (Official page text via search excerpt; see F11.)

title: 31 U.S.C. 5321; 31 CFR 1010.821
what_it_establishes: Willful foreign-financial-agency (FBAR) violation: max = greater of USD 100,000 (statutory) or 50% of transaction/balance. eCFR penalty table (assessed on/after 2025-01-17): statutory USD 100,000 adjusted to USD 165,353. So willful max = greater of USD 165,353 or 50% of balance.

title: Report Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
what_it_establishes: US person with financial interest/signature authority must file FBAR if aggregate foreign accounts exceed USD 10,000 at any time in the calendar year. (Official page text via search excerpt; see F11.)

title: Instructions for Form 8938
what_it_establishes: US-resident single: file if specified foreign financial assets exceed USD 50,000 on last day of year or USD 75,000 at any time; MFJ USD 100,000 / USD 150,000. Higher thresholds if living abroad. (Official page via search excerpt + contents read; see F11.)

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
what_it_establishes: Entering/leaving US with currency/monetary instruments over USD 10,000 must be reported (FinCEN Form 105). Failure risks seizure/forfeiture and civil/criminal penalties.
